bayts.text: O Allah, O You besides Whom there is no god, O You Whose good has come to me without evil,
bless, grant peace and bless forever the one You named Muḥammad,
his Family, his Companions and the prophets; and accept with thanks these introductions, O my Lord.
And he is the one You named "the Beginning" (al-Badʾ), O You Who accepted, by Your Name, my beginning.
O Allah, O You besides Whom there is no god, O You Whose good has come to me without harm,
bless, grant peace and bless forever him whose pre-eminence has appeared from You,
and he is the one You named "the Splendour" (al-Bahāʾ), and the Family and the Companions, without end.
And be my Protector by the right of the formula "I seek refuge in Allah" (the ʿadhbala), and spread over us the blessings of the Basmala.
And bless, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), and grant peace upon the Prophet, beloved of every Muslim,
and he is the one You named "the Illumining" (al-Muḍīʾ), and the Family, the Companions and whoever illumines.
And spread over me the blessings of the Fātiḥa, and make my pens the best opening door.
And bless, O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), and grant peace upon him through whom You dispelled the darknesses,
and he is the one You named "the Radiance" (aḍ-Ḍiyāʾ), and the Family and the Companions possessed of modesty.
And spread over me the blessings of (the sūra) al-Baqara, O You Who turn Your Saqar toward others than me,
and other than it, of every gate of the Fire, of ignominy, loss and dishonour.
And bless, O King (Al-Malik), and grant peace upon him to whom I gave glad tidings with my pen,
and he is the one You named "the Refuge" (al-Maljaʾ), and the Family and the Companions; and reward my taking refuge with thanks.
And spread over me the blessings of Āl ʿImrān, in the present and in the final outcome,
without affliction and without turbidity, O Lord of decree, of creation and of predestination.
And bless, O Holy (Al-Quddūs), with peace, the Prophet, the city of knowledge,
and he is the one You named "the Healing" (ash-Shifāʾ), and the Family and the Companions possessed of fidelity.
And grant me, by the sūra an-Nisāʾ (Women), Your being for me in the morning and the evening,
and the blessings of night and day, without delusion or rebuke,
and protection from harm; and reward this poem with thanks, and illumine my thoughts.
And bless, O Peace (As-Salām), and grant peace upon him through whom You loosed my distress,
and he is called "the Possessor of the mantle", and the Family and the Companions who remove sickness.
And spread over me the blessings of (the sūra) al-Māʾida, and make my life, O Appreciative, a benefit.
And bless, O Giver of security (Al-Muʾmin), with peace, the Prophet of Allah, possessed of teaching,
and he is called "the Possessor of the Banner", and the Family and the Companions, alike.
And grant me, by the sūra al-Anʿām, Your being for me with bounty and grace.
And bless with peace, O Guardian Overseer (Al-Muhaymin), him who after the supplication says "āmīn",
and he is the leader of the prophets, that is, the chief of them all, and they together are radiant heads,
his Family, his Companions, the believing men and the believing women, O Beloved of the submissive.
And make eternal for me the favours of the noble and others, by the sūra al-Aʿrāf.
And write for the best of creation, the Chosen, on my behalf, wishes that last in concealment.
And bless, O Mighty (Al-ʿAzīz), and grant peace upon him who surpassed the noble as a banner,
and he is the orator of the prophets, and the Family and the Companions, in the present and the final outcome.
And grant me, by the sūra al-Anfāl, an opening bearing glad tidings, without closing.
And bless, O Compeller (Al-Jabbār), with peace, him whom my pens have gladdened,
and he is the best of all the prophets, and his Family, his Companions and the Followers.
And spread over me the blessings of (the sūra) at-Tawba, without harm, or enemies, or sin.
O Supreme in Greatness (Al-Mutakabbir), perpetually bless, greeting with peace, the lover, the intimate,
the seal of all the prophets without exception, and the Family and the Companions; and lead piety to me.
And grant me, by the right of (the sūra) Yūnus, the aim, and be for me without harm and without break.
And bless, O Creator (Al-Khāliq), and grant peace upon Your beloved, the intimate, the banner,
and he is the prophet of prophets, the host, and the Family and the Companions, O You Who host,
without movement or roaming, O You Who by abiding effaced its wandering.
And grant me, by the right of (the sūra) Hūd, all that I want from You as a ladder to the Gardens.
And bless, O Originator (Al-Bāriʾ), and grant peace upon him whom You taught, and he knew,
and he is the wealthy, and he is the one cleared of faults, and he is the bold,
his Family and his Companions; and grant me, by the right of (the sūra) Yūsuf, the wishes, without fear.
Bless and grant peace, O Fashioner (Al-Muṣawwir), upon him through whom the sūras came to us,
from You: he is the Light that is not extinguished; and the Family and the Companions; and repel whoever would extinguish (it).
And grant me, by the sūra ar-Raʿd, safety from enemies and the hardships of time.
And bless, O All-Forgiving (Al-Ghaffār), and grant peace upon him who gave glad tidings to whoever learned,
the Chosen, the Elect, the Exalted, and the Family and the Companions, O You Who adorned.
And grant me composition and the gift of making understood, and blessing in all of me, by (the sūra) Ibrāhīm.
And bless, O Subduer (Al-Qahhār), and grant peace upon him who dispels the darkness with my pen,
the Well-Pleasing, the purest, the purified, the most God-fearing, O You Who by his standing opened what was sealed.
